paragraphs: By way of introduction, my name is Joshua Chappell. My intent is to apply for the AI Training & Enablement Specialist position at Guild Mortgage. I feel I have a lot of immediate value I can bring to your organization.

Your posting asks for someone who can translate technical AI capabilities into practical skills for different teams and skill levels. That is the work I have done for years. As a teacher, I elevated 80+ beginner students to 95% camera operation proficiency through hands-on curriculum and assessment. On YouTube, I reached over a million people teaching cutting-edge post-production techniques. I know how to break a complex tool into steps a beginner can follow, and how to check that the lesson stuck.

I bring hands-on AI depth to your rollouts. At Charter One, I used Claude agentic coding to build content workflows that cut production times in half. I work in ChatGPT, Runway, Kling, Veo, and ElevenLabs, so your teams get real use cases, not theory. I maintained an organized library of video assets in Frame.io and Dropbox, reducing search and retrieval time by over 50%, and I will hold your knowledge base to the same standard: accurate, current, and easy to find. My Master's in Marketing Analytics supports the measurement side of the role, from adoption and proficiency to what the feedback says to fix next.
I appreciate that you value customer service, integrity, respect, collaboration, learning, and excellence; these are all values that I strive to emulate.
Thank you for taking the time out of your busy day to read my letter. I look forward to the opportunity of doing an interview with you.
